question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a complete **front-left brake replacement** on your Fjord AWD, the service guide calls for the following. The AWD front disc is 370 mm. (Source: *voltrieve-service-guide.md*)

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
| 1 | Front brake pad set | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 | Front caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, for bleeding | **VP-15168** |

Article numbers are from *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*. The pad set covers **both front wheels**; the service guide says pads are renewed as an axle set, even when only one side is being worked on. (*voltrieve-service-guide.md*)

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
For a complete front-left brake replacement, buy the parts below. **Check whether your Lumen is RWD or AWD before ordering**: the front brakes differ between the two. Each quantity is one. [voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]

| Part | RWD | AWD |
|---|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc | VP-10020 (300 mm) | VP-10033 (320 mm) |
| Front-axle brake pad set | VP-10202 | VP-10215 |
| Front-left brake caliper | VP-10293 | VP-10306 |
| Front-left caliper carrier | VP-10475 | VP-10488 |
| Front-left brake hose | VP-10618 | VP-10618 |
| Front caliper fitting kit | VP-10696 | VP-10696 |
| Front-left brake dust shield | VP-10735 | VP-10735 |
| DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1-litre bottle | VP-15168 | VP-15168 |

The pad set covers **both front wheels**; the service guide says to renew pads as an axle set. The fluid is for bleeding the circuit afterward. The Lumen has no electrical pad-wear sensor. [voltrieve-service-guide.md]

Before work under the car, the service guide says to put it in service mode and never open the orange high-voltage cables. [voltrieve-service-guide.md]
